name: Syed Nazrul Islam
role: Acting President of the Provisional Government
contribution: He preserved constitutional continuity of the wartime state and stabilized political decision-making during a period of leadership disruption.
context: Mujibnagar Government, 1971; amid wartime uncertainty and absent central leadership.
impact: By safeguarding institutional continuity, he helped frame the Liberation War as a legitimate national struggle rather than a fragmented rebellion.
highlight: In uncertainty, he became the constitutional voice of continuity.
